load.error_body: We could not reach the service to start your session. Your draft is safe on this device. Check your connection and try again.
load.no_models_body: Your plan does not include an image model right now. Contact support or check your plan.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.placeholder: Describe what you want to create

realtime.label: Realtime
realtime.usage_one: Previews as you edit · about {{count}} credit each
realtime.usage_other: Previews as you edit · about {{count}} credits each
realtime.paused_provider: Realtime is paused because image generation is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or contact support if it continues.
realtime.paused_credits: Realtime is paused because you do not have enough credits.

input.prompt_only_body: Describe the scene in the prompt. Nothing else is required: no sketch or image is sent. Switch to Sketch or Reference to guide the result with an image.
input.example_timber: A modern timber and glass home in soft morning light
input.example_library: A minimalist concrete library at dusk with warm interior lighting
input.example_courtyard: A quiet courtyard with climbing plants and a small water feature

sketch.clear_body: This removes every stroke from the canvas. You can still describe your idea in the prompt.
sketch.canvas_image: Drawing surface. Use a pointer or touch to draw.
sketch.help: Draw with a mouse, pen or finger. With the canvas focused: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes, +/- zooms. Prefer not to draw? Describe the scene in the prompt or add a reference image.
sketch.limit_reached: The sketch reached its stroke limit. Undo or clear to keep drawing.

reference.title: Add a reference image
reference.body: Drop an image here, paste one from the clipboard, or choose a file. It is used as-is, with its original colors.
reference.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{max}}.
reference.issue_type: This file type is not supported. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
reference.issue_size: This image is too large. The limit is {{max}}.

result.title: Result
result.empty_body: Write a prompt, sketch or add a reference, then press Generate. Turn on Realtime for previews while you edit.
result.cancelled_keep: The generation was stopped. Your previous result is still shown.
result.cancelled_body: The generation was stopped before it finished.
result.expired_body: Unsaved previews are removed after a while. Regenerate to create this image again.
result.save_failed: Could not save this version. Try again.
result.download_failed: Could not download the image. Try again.
result.ready_one: Result ready. {{count}} version in this session.
result.ready_other: Result ready. {{count}} versions in this session.

versions.title: Session versions
versions.empty: Versions you create in this session appear here. Save a version to keep it in your library.

issues.prompt_empty: Describe what you want to create to generate.
issues.prompt_too_long: The prompt is too long. Shorten it to continue.
issues.model_not_entitled: This model is not included in your plan. Choose another model.
issues.size_unsupported: Choose an aspect ratio this model supports.
issues.quality_unsupported: Choose a quality this model supports.
issues.mode_unsupported: This model does not support the selected input mode.
issues.reference_required: Add a reference image to use Reference mode.
issues.reference_uploading: Waiting for the reference image to finish uploading.
issues.reference_failed: The reference image could not be uploaded. Replace it to continue.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while generating. Your draft is kept. Try again.
errors.network: We could not reach Bobby Studio. Your draft is kept and the request will be retried when you are back online.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.session: The studio session could not be restored. Reload the page to continue; your draft is kept.
errors.prepare: The sketch or reference could not be prepared for upload. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: Some settings were not accepted. Review the highlighted fields.
errors.rate_limited_one: Too many requests. Trying again in {{count}} second.
errors.rate_limited_other: Too many requests. Trying again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rate_limited_short: Too many requests. Waiting before the next attempt.
errors.rate_limited_provider: The image service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.credits: You do not have enough credits for this generation.
errors.credits_with_balance: You do not have enough credits for this generation. Available: {{balance}}.
errors.provider_unavailable: The image service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.provider_unavailable_config: Image generation is temporarily unavailable because of a service configuration issue. Try again later or contact support.
errors.no_image: No image was produced for this request. Adjust the prompt and try again.
errors.storage: The result could not be stored. Try again.
errors.deadline: The generation took too long and was stopped. Try again.
